name: cable squat v. 3
description: A squat holding a cable at the chest. The cable adds load and encourages an upright torso.
instructions: Hold a cable handle at your chest and stand with feet shoulder width.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.
